behavior: Native account Documents lookup uses hidden, shell-free commands, preserves redirected/Unicode paths and rejects unavailable or partially qualified roots. Default path is Documents/deepseek-harness/default-workspace.

Lookup cancellation combines the caller and configured positive-integer deadline, releases its timer/listener, and leaves initialization retryable. Existing default identity bypasses a now-aborted caller and survives deletion without recreation.
Candidate-only bindings now mount the current Workspace registry and controller; provider inputs are hashed in application receipts. Production binding/pin remains unchanged.
